name: Old Fashioned
ingredients: 45ml Bourbon or Rye Whiskey, 1 Sugar Cube, 2 dashes Angostura Bitters, Water
desc: A foundational whiskey cocktail that balances sweetness, bitterness, and spirit strength.
recipe: Place a sugar cube in an old-fashioned glass and saturate with 2 dashes of bitters and a few dashes of water.
Muddle the sugar until dissolved.
Fill the glass with ice cubes and add 45ml of whiskey.
Stir gently and garnish with an orange slice and a cocktail cherry.

name: Negroni
desc: An iconic Italian aperitivo known for its vibrant red color and perfectly balanced bitter-sweet profile.
recipe: Pour 30ml gin, 30ml Campari, and 30ml sweet vermouth into an old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently for 30 seconds to chill and achieve proper dilution.
Express the oils of an orange peel over the glass.
Garnish with the orange peel or half an orange slice.

name: Dry Martini
desc: The quintessential sophisticated cocktail, highlighting the botanical profile of dry gin.
recipe: Pour 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth into a mixing glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir well for about 30 seconds until the glass is very cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a green olive or a twist of lemon peel.

name: Manhattan
ingredients: 50ml Rye Whiskey, 20ml Sweet Red Vermouth, 1 dash Angostura Bitters
desc: A smooth, spirit-forward classic that showcases the spice of rye whiskey tempered by herbal vermouth.
recipe: Combine 50ml rye whiskey, 20ml sweet vermouth, and 1 dash of bitters in a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe or cocktail glass.
Garnish with a single maraschino cherry.

name: Daiquiri
ingredients: 60ml White Rum, 20ml Fresh Lime Juice, 2 bar spoons Superfine Sugar
desc: A crisp, refreshing Cuban classic that relies on the perfect ratio of rum to citrus.
recipe: Add 2 bar spoons of sugar and 20ml fresh lime juice to a cocktail shaker; stir to dissolve.
Add 60ml white rum and fill the shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
Double strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Margarita
ingredients: 50ml Tequila (100% Agave), 20ml Triple Sec, 15ml Fresh Lime Juice
desc: The most popular tequila cocktail in the world, balancing sour, sweet, and salty notes.
recipe: Rim a chilled glass with salt using a lime wedge.
Add 50ml tequila, 20ml triple sec, and 15ml lime juice to a shaker with ice.
Shake well until the shaker is frosted.
Strain into the prepared glass over fresh ice or served neat.

name: Espresso Martini
ingredients: 50ml Vodka, 30ml Coffee Liqueur, 10ml Sugar Syrup, 1 shot Fresh Espresso
desc: A modern classic providing a cold, caffeinated kick with a signature frothy head.
recipe: Add 50ml vodka, 30ml coffee liqueur, 10ml sugar syrup, and a fresh shot of espresso to a shaker.
Fill with ice and shake hard to create a thick foam.
Strain immediately into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with three coffee beans in a petal formation.

name: Mojito
ingredients: 45ml White Rum, 20ml Fresh Lime Juice, 6 Mint Sprigs, 2 tsp White Sugar, Soda Water
desc: A vibrant, minty highball that is a staple of Cuban cocktail culture.
recipe: Muddle 6 mint sprigs with 2 tsp sugar and 20ml lime juice in a highball glass.
Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice.
Pour in 45ml rum and stir well.
Top with more soda water and garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Whiskey Sour
ingredients: 45ml Bourbon Whiskey, 30ml Fresh Lemon Juice, 15ml Simple Syrup, 1 bar spoon Egg White
desc: A rich, silky cocktail that balances the bite of bourbon with tart citrus.
recipe: Combine 45ml bourbon, 30ml lemon juice, 15ml syrup, and egg white in a shaker.
Shake without ice first (dry shake) to create foam.
Add ice and shake again (wet shake) until cold.
Strain into a chilled glass and garnish with a cherry.

name: Cosmopolitan
ingredients: 40ml Vodka Citron, 15ml Cointreau, 15ml Fresh Lime Juice, 30ml Cranberry Juice
desc: A stylish, tart-sweet cocktail made famous by modern pop culture.
recipe: Add 40ml vodka, 15ml Cointreau, 15ml lime juice, and 30ml cranberry juice to a shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously.
Double strain into a large chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lime wheel or flamed orange zest.
